name: order_afb_culture
description: Orders an acid-fast bacilli (AFB) culture and smear for Mycobacterium tuberculosis and non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM). AFB cultures require extended incubation (up to 8 weeks). Includes AFB smear for rapid detection.

specimen_source.description: Source of specimen (sputum, bronchial wash, CSF, urine, tissue, blood)

number_of_specimens.description: Number of specimens to collect (typically 3 sputum specimens for respiratory TB)

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering AFB culture

when_to_use: Extrapulmonary TB (lymph node, bone, CNS, GU)
Positive TB skin test or IGRA with symptoms
NTM infection suspected in CF or structural lung disease

examples.query: Send sputum for AFB smear, culture, and GeneXpert

args.clinical_indication: cough, hemoptysis, and right upper lobe cavitary lesion
